title: Github bugs capture anthropic API keys
body:
When I submit a bug in the CLI and then redirect to github, the report it creates includes an Anthropic API key in the "errors" section.

When I tried to submit a bug about THAT, I got an error in the title of the bug that starts "https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/new?title=I%20apologize%2C%20but%20I%20cannot%20and%20will%20not ..." so it also looks like you're sending bug reports through claude itself, and it fails.
author: jwatte
